blurb.en: Eight-bit chip synth, knob per function, no menus. Sounds like a console being pushed somewhere it should not go.
blurb.fi: Kahdeksanbittinen chip-syna, nuppi per toiminto, ei valikoita. Kuulostaa konsolilta, jota työnnetään sinne, minne ei pitäisi.
blurb.sv: Åttabitars chipsynt, en ratt per funktion, inga menyer. Låter som en konsol som pressas dit den inte borde.

reviews.title: Twisted Electrons Therapkid Duophonic Chiptune Synthesizer Announced

pull.q: This duo-phonic synthesizer combines the best elements of the first generation of SID with those of the later ones.

quotes.t: This gives users the strong filter resonance that characterized the 8580 along with the gritty tone of the 6581.
The unit is very compact but has a sturdy feel to it.
